title: Waveform-based pulse timing enhanced by self-supervised neural regression models for digital nuclear instrumentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17356v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the rapid development of high-sampling-rate digital nuclear devices, their applications in nuclear facilities and related fields become more acceptable, and will possibly become widespread due to the versatility and flexibility of waveform sampling systems. When digitizers reach hundreds of megahertz or gigahertz, their lower limit in time measurement probes into the sub-nanosecond region, expediting their use in a bunch of time-critical scenarios. While conventional algorithms coupled with digital sampling techniques realize fair pulse timing in certain conditions, the potentials are still open to compact and efficient machine learning models. In this paper, we intend to boost the performance of pulse timing with a new paradigm of self-supervised learning on matched waveform pairs. translated_title: 基于自监督神经回归模型增强的数字核仪器波形脉冲定时方法
translated_abstract: 随着高采样率数字核设备的快速发展，其在核设施及相关领域的应用日益普及，并凭借波形采样系统的通用性和灵活性有望得到广泛推广。当数字化仪达到数百兆赫兹或吉赫兹级别时，其时间测量下限可深入至亚纳秒区域，加速了此类设备在众多时间敏感场景中的应用。尽管传统算法结合数字采样技术已在特定条件下实现了较为理想的脉冲定时，但紧凑高效的机器学习模型的潜力仍有待挖掘。本文旨在通过一种基于匹配波形对自监督学习的新范式来提升脉冲定时性能。所提出的方法将主流的自监督损失与参考集上的辅助弱监督损失相结合，共同提升了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于匹配波形对的、结合自监督损失与辅助弱监督损失的神经回归新范式，显著提升了数字核仪器中波形脉冲定时的精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new self-supervised learning paradigm on matched waveform pairs, combining mainstream self-supervised loss with auxiliary weakly-supervised loss in neural regression models to enhance pulse timing performance for digital nuclear instrumentation.
